name: teradata-vantage-plugin
title_zh: 19 个技能打包管住 Teradata Vantag
tagline_zh: 建表、加载、调优、迁移，日常要写的 SQL 和运维脚本它都备好了；19 个技能按任务分格，装一次不用再逐个找。
tagline_en: DDL, loading, tuning, migration: the SQL and ops scripts you write daily, pre-packed as 19 task-scoped skills.
why_zh: 按任务切分而不是按 API 罗列，每个技能自带该场景的语法约束和常见坑，省掉翻文档对版本的时间。
why_en: Split by task, not by API: each skill carries its scenario's syntax rules and pitfalls, so no doc-diving per version.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Teradata Vantage 这一套：换成别的数仓、或要跨库联邦查询，它给不出可用脚本。
limit_en: Vantage only: other warehouses or cross-DB federation get no usable scripts, and version differences are still yours to check.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 19 skills that cover everyday Teradata Vantage work
